title: DISRUPTION OF A DNA REPAIR PROTEIN PROMOTES ANTIBIOTIC RESISTANCE IN ACINETOBACTER BAUMANNII
authors: Suman Tiwari; Syed H. Raza; Namrata Bonde; Roberto Jhonatan Olea-Ozuna; Tuhina Maity; Muneer Yaqub; Tahira Amdid Ratna; Kelli Palmer; Joseph Boll; Jonathan Monk; Nicholas A. Dillon
one_liner_zh: 该文研究DNA修复蛋白RuvB破坏如何通过eDNA生物膜促进鲍曼不动杆菌抗生素耐药，虽涉及DNA相关蛋白但非TF-DNA互作，且无AI/物理模拟结合建模，仅用机器学习预测基因关联，与本课题核心无关。
abstract: Acinetobacter baumannii is a high-priority Gram negative opportunistic pathogen known for its high rates of multidrug resistance (MDR). Minocycline (MIN), a tetracycline class antibiotic, is one of the most effective antibiotics for treating A. baumannii infections in patients. Unfortunately, MIN resistance is spreading internationally and has begun to emerge in the United States. While efflux pumps are correlated with MIN resistant A. baumannii , clinical data suggests alternative mechanisms of MIN resistance. To explore the genetic basis for MIN resistance in A. baumannii we employed a machine learning model to predict genetic resistance correlates from clinical isolates. Mutations in ruvB , a DNA repair protein, were strongly correlated with MIN resistant clinical strains of A. baumannii . Consistent with the prediction, tn26 insertion in ruvB in A. baumannii strain AB5075, and deletion of ruvB in strain ATCC 19606, increased MIN minimum inhibitory concentrations to a level that exceeds the MIN resistance breakpoint. RuvB complexes with RuvA and RuvC to resolve Holliday junctions during recombination. However, only ruvB mutants showed the resistance phenotype; neither ruvA nor ruvC mutants were MIN resistant, suggesting loss of the complex’s activity was not the basis for resistance. We observed ruvB mutants produced increased biomass during planktonic growth relative to the other two ruv mutants. Upon examination, the ruvB ::tn26 mutant had a 451% increase in biomass and 360% thicker biofilms relative to wildtype. We determined the disruption of ruvB lead to thicker biofilms and enriched in extracellular DNA (eDNA), and DNase I treatment collapsed the enhanced biofilm phenotype and markedly reduced tetracycline-class MICs. FLAG–RuvA accumulated within the biofilm matrix in the absence of RuvB, supporting a model in which RuvA contributes to stabilization of eDNA-rich structures. In a murine pneumonia model, ruvB disruption did not significantly alter survival or pulmonary burden in untreated infection but reduced bacterial dissemination and increased minocycline resistance. Together, these findings reveal an unexpected connection between Holliday junction processing, eDNA-rich biofilm architecture, and antibiotic resistance in A. baumannii .
abstract_zh: 鲍曼不动杆菌（Acinetobacter baumannii）是一种高优先级革兰阴性机会性病原体，以其高比例的多重耐药性（MDR）而闻名。米诺环素（MIN），一种四环素类抗生素，是治疗患者鲍曼不动杆菌感染最有效的抗生素之一。不幸的是，MIN耐药性正在国际范围内传播，并已开始在美国出现。虽然外排泵与MIN耐药的鲍曼不动杆菌相关，但临床数据提示存在MIN耐药的其他机制。为探索鲍曼不动杆菌中MIN耐药的遗传基础，我们采用机器学习模型从临床分离株中预测遗传耐药相关性。ruvB（一种DNA修复蛋白）中的突变与MIN耐药的鲍曼不动杆菌临床菌株强烈相关。与预测一致，在鲍曼不动杆菌菌株AB5075中插入tn26于ruvB，以及在菌株ATCC 19606中删除ruvB，均将MIN最低抑菌浓度提高至超过MIN耐药折点的水平。RuvB与RuvA和RuvC形成复合物，在重组过程中解析霍利迪连接（Holliday junction）。然而，仅ruvB突变体表现出耐药表型；ruvA或ruvC突变体均不具MIN耐药性，表明该复合物活性的丧失并非耐药的基础。我们观察到，与其他两种ruv突变体相比，ruvB突变体在浮游生长期间产生更多生物量。经检查，ruvB::tn26突变体相对于野生型，生物量增加451%，生物膜厚度增加360%。我们确定ruvB的破坏导致生物膜增厚，并富集胞外DNA（eDNA），而DNase I处理可瓦解增强的生物膜表型，并显著降低四环素类药物的最低抑菌浓度。在缺乏RuvB的情况下，FLAG–RuvA在生物膜基质中积累，支持RuvA有助于稳定富含eDNA结构的模型。在小鼠肺炎模型中，ruvB破坏在未治疗感染中未显著改变生存率或肺部细菌负荷，但减少了细菌播散并增加了米诺环素耐药性。综合来看，这些发现揭示了鲍曼不动杆菌中霍利迪连接加工、富含eDNA的生物膜结构和抗生素耐药性之间的意外联系。
